name: web-mega-menu-with-brand-preview-card-and-titled-link-list
title: Top nav 'Home, Components, Docs, List, Simple, With Icon' with an open mega menu: a grey preview card and three titled links
whatItIs: A white page with a text nav where 'Home' is active with an up chevron under a cursor, and a bordered white dropdown panel with a soft grey card at the left titled 'ReUI' with a description and, at the right, three items (Introduction, Installation, Typography), each with a bold title and a grey description.
whatItMeans: Organised and quiet; a preview card plus descriptive links helps choose a destination.
techniques: Open a panel with a preview card and link list.
Give each link a title and description.
Mark the active nav item with a chevron.

vocabulary.definition: A large dropdown with multiple links and a preview.
A card in a menu summarising the section.
A link with a title and explanatory line.
An arrow showing the open state.
